articles.title: ISS gains new commander as Crew-11 prepares midweek departure
articles.summary: NASA astronaut Mike Fincke took over command of the International Space Station on Dec. 7, 2025. He and the rest of the SpaceX Crew-11 mission will undock from the ISS on Jan. 14.
